title: Diagnostic mammogram, one breast
description: The provider performs X–ray imaging on one breast in a patient with a known lump or suspected cancer and may use specially designed computer software to help identify or diagnose potential abnormalities within the images; the software converts signals into digital data and analyzes the images.
policy_context:
## Table of CPT Codes for Diagnostic Mammography
77065, Description = Diagnostic mammography, including computer-aided detection when performed; unilateral. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 are limited to two screenings per year. | ## Mammography With Xeroradiography
Providers must use CPT codes 77065 for unilateral diagnostic mammography and 77066 for bilateral diagnostic mammography whether or not xeroradiography was used in the examination. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 may be billed with modifiers U7 or 99 as appropriate and cannot both be billed on the same day for the same recipient.
expected_checklist:
- Check symptoms or abnormal clinical findings.
- Check whether there was an abnormal prior screening or follow-up indication.
- Check laterality (left, right, unilateral, bilateral, one/both breasts).

description: The provider performs X–ray imaging on one breast in a patient with a known lump or suspected cancer and may use specially designed computer software to help identify or diagnose potential abnormalities within the images; the software converts signals into digital data and analyzes the images.
policy_context:
## Table of CPT Codes for Diagnostic Mammography
77065, Description = Diagnostic mammography, including computer-aided detection when performed; unilateral. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 are limited to two screenings per year. | ## Mammography With Xeroradiography
Providers must use CPT codes 77065 for unilateral diagnostic mammography and 77066 for bilateral diagnostic mammography whether or not xeroradiography was used in the examination. CPT codes 77065 and 77066 may be billed with modifiers U7 or 99 as appropriate and cannot both be billed on the same day for the same recipient.
expected_checklist:
- Check symptoms or abnormal clinical findings.
- Check whether there was an abnormal prior screening or follow-up indication.
- Check laterality (left, right, unilateral, bilateral, one/both breasts).
